scope.purpose: Investigate five null Wikipedia targets against live article bodies and relevant list/shared sections; no draft edits.

method: Read each current draft and evidence sidecar; confirmed knownBy and fixed WEB citation; searched exact-name and candidate-title queries; opened current Wikipedia body at the cited locator. Classification distinguishes same-person article/section from a merely related family member or phrase. Current draft/evidence SHA are byte hashes. No source article body hashes were exposed by the browser, so locators and access timestamp are recorded instead.

primary.gateDisposition: first safe/explicit occurrence; no earlier person reference found in assigned-book evidence

independentWikipediaRead.title: List of minor Hebrew Bible figures, A–K
independentWikipediaRead.supportJa: 記事はベン・アビナダブをソロモンの地域行政官として1 Kings 4:11に結び付ける。Abinadab節(L211–214)は別の同名者を列挙し、父本人を同定しない。ベン・アビナダブ項を関連項目としてのみ示すのが適切。

independentWikipediaRead.title: Rei (given name)
independentWikipediaRead.supportJa: 本文はReiをヘブライ語の聖書上の名として挙げ、アドニヤの簒奪時にダビデに忠誠を保ったイスラエル人と説明する。1 Kings 1:8の人物と明確に対応。一般タイトルReiの曖昧さは別ページで、対象記事はgiven-nameの説明。
independentWikipediaRead.scopeJa: The page’s biblical paragraph explicitly describes the Israelite Rei loyal to David during Adonijah’s usurpation, matching the named person at 1 Kings 1:8.
independentWikipediaRead.limitationJa: Rei disambiguation page itself does not identify the biblical figure; use Rei (given name), whose body does. Gate1:8.
